verdicts.why: Luis gets into Hope's van during the chase, she shrinks it to get past Burch's fleet, then tells him to bring the remote using the Hot Wheels collection.
Sitwell warns Coulson and Coulson calls Clint up. Clint and Sitwell never deal with each other, and the tie already exists, so no stage.
Hank and Charles use Cerebro to trace the Cairo surge, and after Stryker the group flies to Cairo and rescues Xavier.
Jean joins Erik and helps him take apart Apocalypse's armor, then incinerates him. Afterwards Erik and Jean rebuild the school together.
Raven, Moira, Hank and Alex carry the unconscious Charles out of Cerebro, and then Alex dies in the explosion at the mansion.
Scott, Jean and Kurt free McCoy and others from Stryker, and later McCoy and Raven train the recruits, Jean among them.
Ororo turns on En Sabah Nur alongside Erik and Scott while Jean finishes him. Both are then among the new X-Men trained together.
Scott, Jean and Kurt free Peter and the others from Stryker, and they all go on to Cairo.
Tony runs the Mark XLVII remotely to save Peter. When Tony ends the call, F.R.I.D.A.Y. takes over the suit's controls and flies it away.
Pepper, who set up the press conference at Tony's request, runs out and asks whether Tony and Happy have ruined the plan.
Happy is Peter's contact for Tony and oversees the move out of Avengers Tower. At the compound he gives Tony the ring.
Stark saves Peter from the lake, takes back the suit after the ferry, and Peter turns down his offer to join the Avengers.
In Cairo they attack Apocalypse at the same time but never exchange anything. A shared battle without an exchange is no stage.
T'Challa dies of his illness, and Ayo carries his casket at the funeral. A death is a stage.
M'Baku goes to T'Challa's funeral and mourns him, the only one who does not cross his arms in salute.
M'Baku and Okoye trade insults at the emergency council. During the flood Okoye yells at M'Baku and Aneka to get Shuri away.
Nakia talks with Okoye about T'Challa, they rescue civilians during the flood, and Nakia tells Okoye it is too late to save Ramonda.
In Monaco Everhart, there to interview Hammer, tries to make Stark jealous, is put down when he mentions their tryst, and asks him about Hammer.
Everhart asks Potts for a quote on her promotion to CEO, and Potts jokes that 'she did quite a... spread on Tony last year.'
Stark has Dum-E help synthesize the new element, then makes it clean up the mess.
In Monaco Hogan drives onto the track while Potts unlocks the suitcase armor's handcuff. At the party he pulls her to safety, and he is now her bodyguard as CEO.
Hogan and Stark box together, and at Monaco Hogan rams Vanko into the fence and gets the armor to Stark.

value.title: Iron Man 2
value.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Tony study his father's notes and create a new element to replace the palladium poisoning him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The creator J.A.R.V.I.S. helps make a new element.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The AI that helps Tony create his new element.

verdicts.why: The event is right: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Stark work out and synthesize the new element. The line on J.A.R.V.I.S.'s card reads as if J.A.R.V.I.S. is the creator, so it gets an article.
Potts tells Rhodes where Stark is, hoping he can talk sense into him, and at the party she pulls Rhodes in to deal with a drunk Stark.
Fury leaves Coulson at Stark's mansion with orders not to let him leave until he finds a cure.
Fury reveals Romanoff, has her give Stark lithium dioxide, gives him Howard's materials, and at the debriefing keeps Stark on only as a consultant.
Both are on the Sea Leopard, and Fandom says only that they order a retreat, with no exchange between them shown. A shared battle without an exchange is no stage.
In the credits scene, which belongs to the film, Tony tells Bruce about his ordeal at Avengers Tower and Bruce falls asleep, saying he is not that kind of doctor.
Tony puts a dunce cap on Dum-E during the Mark XLII test and later takes the robots' remains from the mansion rubble.
Hogan, the new head of security, watches over Pepper during Killian's visit and tells her her car is ready when he leaves.
Hogan lies in a coma at Cedars-Sinai after the bombing. Stark stays at his bedside and then publicly threatens the Mandarin.
In the 1999 Bern opening, Yinsen comes up to a drunk Stark, who brushes him off with a joke about finally meeting a man called Ho.
J.A.R.V.I.S. pilots the suit to Tennessee, and at the end Stark orders him to destroy all the suits.
Rhodes is at Tony's surgery with Potts and gives Tony a thumbs up before he goes under.
Stark and Rhodes team up, get onto the platform together, and Rhodes takes the President to safety while Stark fights Killian.
